account_id.description: The owning account ID (a biz_ identifier). Provide this or user_id.

user_id.description: The owning user ID (a user_ identifier). Provide this or account_id.

currency.description: Optional currency code filter, for example `usd`.

status.description: Filter to payouts whose `status` reads this word, matching exactly what this version displays — `reversed` finds settled payouts the bank later returned. Requires Api-Version-Date 2026-08-21 or later.

source.description: Filter by how the payout was created. Payouts created before source tracking or through internal tooling carry no source and never match.

payout_method_id.description: Filter to payouts sent to one saved payout method (a pytk_ identifier). An unknown id matches nothing.

created_before.description: Only payouts created before this ISO 8601 time (exclusive).

created_after.description: Only payouts created at or after this ISO 8601 time (inclusive).

first.description: Number of results to return from the start of the range.

after.description: Return results after this cursor. Use `page_info.end_cursor` from the previous response to fetch the next page.

last.description: Number of results to return from the end of the range.

before.description: Return results before this cursor. Use `page_info.start_cursor` from the previous response to fetch the previous page.
